reviews.text: This game is easy to pick up yet still has plenty of depth and complexity to stay interesting. Pew pew

[h1]巫妖之门：幸存塔：幸存者的全新玩法[/h1] [h2]前言 [/h2] 玩之前没想过游戏能这么好玩，结果实际上手后游戏不仅操作只用鼠标啥的比较舒服，内容上又有类幸存者给的爽快割草的爽快感，加上游戏多种流派和道具等等，可玩法方面可以说是做到了极致 [h2]玩法 [/h2] 游戏与其他幸存者不同的一点是，游戏中我们没有需要操控的角色，也不需要通过走位来规避敌人你的伤害，我们需要做的只有在商店中不停的购买技能，被动效果，通过技能攻击从四周源源不断进攻的敌人，击败敌人后会获得金币 我们需要在敌人的攻势中撑过50波，类幸存者游戏经典的三选一也保留了，我们每撑过5波游戏就会让我们在三个选项中进行选择，而需要注意的是，每次都会有负面效果在，比如生成额外的对应种族的敌人，而不同种族的敌人会对某种属性技能的攻击克制和被克制的关系，我们需要合理分配自己拿的技能类型 而游戏中不同的唯一道具，技能升级等等都需要我们进行合理分配，商店每隔一段时间会自动刷新，也可以手动消耗金币刷新 游戏有多种难度和初始道具不同的情况让我们进行游玩，游戏有一定的局外养成，整体难度其实不算低，不过不同技能的不同攻击方式，而每种攻击方式都有强化词条，内容相当丰富 [h2]总结 [/h2] 很推荐喜欢幸存者的人尝试，尽管没有可操控的角色，但游戏也有相当优秀的机制和很丰富的内容，以及还算精致的画面，肉鸽的特性展示的也很不错 [quote]欢迎前来关注「 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45353266/] 𝗞𝗼𝗶𝗺𝗶𝗮𝗼🍁」 [/url] [u][b] 采撷旅途之叶，铭刻生命之诗[/b][/u][/quote]

Fun game, good difficulty rampup. Already feel like I got my moneys worth. Only thing I feel could be improved is the roguelite upgrades outside of rounds. Mainly missing some possible upgrades. Examples of things i'd like; a free starter uncommon weapon, starting with a relic, more gold to start with, reducing enemy mob hp/dmg.
Fun little game, looks clean and the gameplay is smooth, totally worth the price.
Simple mechanics, simple game, enjoyable!

The game was very disappointing. You can see all the possible content in just 3 hours. I'd leave a neutral review, but that's not allowed, and having all positive reviews is unfair. Pros: + Concept (the idea itself seems to have good potential) + Implementation (no bugs or mechanical issues have been noticed in the game) + Price (regardless of the amount of content) Cons: - Terrible meta-progression (the worst possible) - Low variability - Weapon and upgrade balance - Randomness - Length - Replayability in the current build - Primitive challenges It's not a bad game, but if you have TD experience, there's nothing to be gained here. It's like a simple phone game. However, I believe that with some effort, the game can be developed into something independent and distinctive. The foundation and engine are there – it needs more complexity and depth, and some work on replayability

It is a decent game, but has pretty low replay value. It takes very little time to unlock basically everything, and the available tower unlocks really only consist of two types, one with an extra life, and four that offer increased chance of specific weapon types. Imo, even the tower type is a fail, multistrike/bounce/splash/etc. would have been much more (relatively) enjoyable towers to play with. The game has a ton of potential, but things like progression and end of wave 50 just make me want something more. Very on the fence recommending it, I am not quite sure it is worth $7 in it's current state if one is looking for something more than a day or two of play. I really hope to see a few updates down the road! Tl;Dr - Game play is a ton of fun, however, it is somewhat shallow. Progression feels like an afterthought, short game currently. Edit: Play time is due to hitting wave 50 and needing to leave for work, managed to squeeze out wave 75 and 9hrs of "playtime" (actually hours played is closer to 10 with demo)

Beautiful rogue-lite tower defense auto battler. Active dev. A lot of different builds to choose from. The game is unique in that every 5th wave there's a chance to get an upgrade. Each upgrade has a positive effect, (+gold gain, a powerup, higher tier options, etc.,) and a negative effect, (+more elite enemies, stronger base enemies, more base enemies, etc.) Each weapon type is effective to a certain type of enemy, and also ineffective against another type. Choosing your upgrades wisely is the key to success. Fun game that I would recommend you pick up, especially with such a fair price point.

it's a decent adaption even though i prefer the 4 weapon slot and 4 upgrade slots of the original wc3 map. having only 2 of each feels much more limiting, like apart from the basic categories it feels way to hard to do any secondary categorie challenge runs like wave, burn, bounce, etc only. Still for the price you get a decent game with lots of potential if new archetypes and strategies (and more shop slots) get introduced

Fun game that feels deceptively simple but has a lot of varied and deep builds. Nice twist on the genre. Leaderboards mean you keep hitting reset late into the evening :D I do wish the reroll of the shop would reset the timer.
I've been having a lot of fun with this game, it makes me very nostalgic for older flash games. Easy to understand the game play and a good difficulty ramp up.

Highly recommend this game. It manages to be both simple and surprisingly complex. At its core, the concept is straightforward: you control a single tower, purchase weapons and upgrades (more HP, more damage, etc.), and fend off waves of incoming enemies. At first, it feels eas, you can get through runs by buying things at random and might think, “That’s it?” But the depth quickly reveals itself: - Achievements push you to experiment with a wide range of strategies, some of which are genuinely challenging - There are 9 difficulty levels. The early ones are approachable, but the higher tiers become seriously demanding - The leaderboard adds another layer of motivation, not just to reach the standard ending at wave 50, but to push for the true ending at wave 100 or maximize damage against the boss wave 50 As others have mentioned, this is the kind of game that keeps you hitting “replay”—whether to beat your personal best, tackle higher difficulties, or complete tricky achievements (like using only one weapon type). 100% worth the 7USD/EUR/GBP !

Really enjoyable alt-monitor game. Not too demanding of your attention, you can pause it at any time. Finding the balance of economy, offense and defense is nice. I enjoy the variety of weapons for high DPS vs utility vs scaling. The play decisions really center around where you choose to spend your money, how many small upgrades you buy vs rushing rerolls for more powerful weapons and upgrades. Hoping the game gets updates and some additional weapons/play options.

Pros: Interesting twist to the formula with the tower. Enemy power scaling every 5 levels based on your choice of buff adds a very neat tactical consideration. Good price. Also comes with a tutorial which not every survivor game bothers to include. Cons: Uninteresting meta progression and boring unlocks. The meta progression is just a small percentage increase to a stat. No new weapons to unlock, only new towers. But the new towers just manipulate shop RNG. I'd say make the towers more unique. Like make a tower do less weapon damage but do crazy thorns damage. Make a tower have massive splash and zones but less single target damage for example.
pretty cool little game and honestly worth the money for sure if you try and complete it.
not good

I'm rather new to Tower Defense games as a genre, but this game is quick to pick up, and will pull you right in! I've done a handful of runs and already sunk over three hours into the early game and I have to say there are so many quality of life features. To list a few: Speeding up time - great for just burning through build tests or grinding XP for upgrades Hovering over items in the shop will highlight compatible weapons and upgrades you already own - great for build synergy gamepad, mouse, or keyboard inputs - great accessibility features On a note of personal taste, I would specifically like to say I enjoy the music quite a bit, most games I turn down or off the in game music and listen to my own, but this has a good energy to it, fits the theme of the game. Also I rather enjoy the shape language and simple cartoony style of the mobs. It makes it easier on the eyes, especially with the frequent particle effects. Despite the eventual chaos of higher waves the game is not a mush of unreadable pixels. Really just well done little game that knows what it's about. And that is min-maxxing the heck out of your stats to be a perfect killing machine!

fun game, but it has not enough content! you saw every combination after like a few hours which is sad. The idea of the game is really fun though and when this is updated for a while I will play again and then hopefully give a positive review :)

Very fun and addictive game for those who enjoy the thrill of high rolling into amazing builds/upgrades. Much like the many other roguelikes out there, Lichgate is intuitive for new players and at the same time provides a refreshing set of tough challenges for experienced players. If you're looking to enjoy a boat load of fun and grinding of challenges, Lichgate is definitely worth checking out.

I think its an ok game but it didn't vibe with me. check it out to see if is good for you. most of the time I've spent in the game was looking at upgrades that refreshed every 10 secs so that is the gameplay loop that stood out to me. Its like it wants to be an idle game and a td game and doesn't do either of them well. Some people might like this but its like 75% RNG and 25% knowing what build you want to go for. Again, its not a bad game some people might enjoy it but I am not one of those guys

Loving it - in my opinion - hunting down all the achievements is a great challenge, but also not overly tiresome, getting a feel for all the different builds, picks, when to reroll and when to buy i great feel, and one session doesn't take too long. Also - decided to write this review purely to cry at myself for having the best gate 9 burn run and accidentally picking hel strike instead of hel damage... Did get the secret achievement though :) I guess one piece of feedback i'd give - at gate 9 - when running a specific build - I'd almost always try to reroll the shop until i get an exact weapon - which is slightly tedious and time consuming, would've liked to have the option to select what one thing i would like to see at first in the shop.

A neat transformation of the Tower Survivor Warcraft 3 map with pretty much all the features that one has. Just needs more tower options (like the mixed element ones the WC3 map has), more upgrades and overall more content/progression and it'll be perfect. Definitely worth for the price even now
一坨，跟无尽塔防没得比，甚至免费。

EDIT: I no longer have mixed feelings. This game's meta-progression sucks. Out loud and hard. Which means that trying to progressing through the game sucks. Out loud and hard. 100 failed runs to net a 4% additive bonus to something when all the meta-progression requires a x2 multiplicative demand. Wish I could refund this game. The gameplay loop with "rock, paper, scissors. +1" is fine. Moving through the gates/play progression just doesn't feel good. Then we get to the meta-progression. Man, no idea whose brain-child this was... Awful. Every "level up" you get 4, only 4, of the resources needed to upgrade your meta passives. Every level doubles the amount needed for the next level. It's not linear, it's exponential: IE: 1 -> 2 -> 4 -> 8 -> 16 -> 32, etc. Each meta upgrade only offers a 4% LINEAR upgrade. The math isn't mathing for a the gameplay reward because this game will force you for fail consistently on the same map only to crawl for the meta progression that MAY let you pass it. No skill. Pure awful RNG and meta design.
